slots.title: Two Hours That Could Protect Everything

items.title: How to Keep Your Home Out of Court

body.text: Why a will alone isn’t enough — and the one document that keeps your family out of probate court entirely.

items.title: Who's in Charge If You Can't Be

body.text: The two legal documents that name the right person to handle your finances and medical decisions if you ever can’t.
Legally name the right guardian — and make sure your children are cared for exactly the way you want, not a judge.
Know exactly which documents make up a complete estate plan — and what happens to your family without each one.

items.title: How to Protect What You've Built

body.text: Shield your assets from unnecessary taxes, creditors, and costly legal fees with the right plan in place.
Leave with a clear, customized action plan — not just general information. Know exactly what YOU need to do.

slots.title: This Workshop Is for You If…

cards.title: You Have Children
text: Make sure your kids are protected and the right guardian is legally named — no matter what.

cards.title: You're Married
text: Ensure your spouse can access everything they need without court delays or legal roadblocks.

cards.title: You Own a Home
text: Pass your home directly to your family — no probate, no courthouse, no delays.

cards.title: You Have Savings
text: Protect what you’ve worked for and make sure it goes exactly where you intend.

cards.title: Your Plan Is Outdated
text: Had a major life change? Marriage, divorce, new children? Your old documents may no longer protect you.

cards.title: You Have No Plan Yet
text: No pressure. This free workshop is the perfect place to start — and to finally get it done.

cards.title: You Recently Moved to Florida
text: Florida has its own unique estate planning laws. A plan from another state may not protect you here — come find out what needs to change.

Yes — completely free. No cost to attend, no obligation to purchase anything, and no pressure. Vaughn Law hosts these workshops because we genuinely care about protecting families in our community.

Anyone who has family, owns anything, or wants to make sure their wishes are honored. Whether you’re 30 or 70, a first-time planner or someone with an outdated will — this workshop was designed for you.
Approximately two hours. We start on time, end on time, and reserve time at the end for questions and one-on-one conversation with our attorney(s).

items.title: Should I bring my spouse or partner?

body.text: Absolutely — we encourage it. Estate planning is a family decision, and couples who attend together get much more out of the experience. Just note how many guests are coming when you register.

items.title: What is the Legacy Design Meeting?

body.text: A private, one-hour session with one of our estate planning attorneys where they design your personal estate plan — built specifically for your family situation. Available to workshop attendees at $200 (regularly $350), with your full $200 credited toward your completed estate plan.

Anyone who has family, owns anything, or wants to make sure their wishes are honored. Whether you’re 30 or 70, a first-time planner or someone with an outdated will — this workshop was designed for you.

items.title: Do I need to bring anything?

body.text: Just yourself and your questions. If you have an existing will or trust, you’re welcome to bring it — but it’s not required to attend or benefit from the workshop.

items.title: What if I can't make any of the listed dates?

body.text: Use the waitlist link below the event listings and we’ll contact you as soon as a new workshop is available. We add new dates every month across St. Petersburg and Tampa.
